text: The orthodontist is good, the scaling was painless and sensitive for me, and the wisdom tooth extraction was also okay. The price is a bit high, but based on reviews and my own experience, it's worth it. I've been using the clinic for 5 years, and this year is the first year they've had appointments that haven't been kept. They scheduled an appointment for 2 PM, but when they called to confirm, they said to come at 3 PM. This has happened so many times that I'm confused why they even bother giving appointment times if they don't need to specify a time. It's not a problem for me, but what if someone has their own plans already? I don't know if the other times were due to the doctor rescheduling or the staff messing up the schedule, but the first time they missed an appointment was because of staff error. They scheduled me for 5 PM, but when they called to confirm, they said I could come at 2 PM. My case was just a quick check-up, so I booked a movie ticket. After I booked it, the same staff member called again saying it had to be 5 PM, not 2 PM, without any apology. It was like they were just informing me. I had to reschedule for another day because it wasn't convenient for me anymore. I hope they improve this aspect of their service. In previous years, there were never any problems with appointment times; the clinic was always very punctual.
